main_text.p: Ithpah. Accingi, accingere se, accinctu esse, armari. זריו, זריין Ch. Accinctus, expeditus, promptus, festinus. Plur. זריזין, Fœm. זריזא, זריזתא, Plur. זריזין.
זרזא, זרזי Ch. Cingulum, cinctorium, subligaculum. Plur. זרזין.
זריזותא Ch. Festinatio: בזריזותא Cum festinatione, festinanter. Levit.9.8. in Jon.
זרע Ch. & Syr. Serere, seminare, conserere: Disseminare, dispergere. Jacob.1.1. & 1.Pet.1.1. Ithpeh. אזדרע Seminari.
זרעא זרע Ch. & Syr. Semen, Sementis. Plur. cum Aff. וזרעיכון Et semina vestra, 1. Sam. 8.15. Syr. Seminibus tuis, ad Gal.3.16.
זרעונין, זרועין Ch. Sata, Sativa, Lev.11.37. in Jon. Jesa.61.11.
זרעיתא זרעית, זרעי Ch. Semè, posteritas, familia, cognatio, stirps. Plur. זרעיתא, זרעין.
אזרע Ch. Brachium. Plur. cum aff. מאזרעיהון Ex brachiis ipsarum, Num.31.50. in Targ. Hierosol.
זרק Chal. Spargere, aspergere, confpergere: Item Conjicere, projicere, Esther.5.14. Ithpeh. אזדרק Aspergi, conspergi.
מזרקא, מזרק Chald. Crater, phiala. Plural. מזרקין, em-

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic/Chaldee words are printed in Hebrew letters; transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Some Hebrew forms with points are only approximated and may contain errors. Marginal text at right is faint and not legible, so not transcribed.
